audit.whatIsWrong: Two separate fabrications. (a) Irelia's passive is credited with shredding Ornn's resists in six places (tldr, winCon, whys[4], whys[6], spikes[1].text, mid, late, wants.you[1]). (b) Ornn is credited with a shield that heals — 'melts him faster than his shield can heal', 'out-damages his shield healing'. Ornn has neither.
audit.why: Ionian Fervor is stacking Attack Speed plus bonus on-hit damage at max stacks. Ornn's kit is Living Forge (bonus resists from all sources, item forging), Volcanic Rupture, Bellows Breath (Brittle), Searing Charge (terrain knockup), Call of the Forge God — no shield and no heal anywhere. The shred fiction is load-bearing: the whole 'drag him into a long fight' plan is justified by an effect that does not exist, when the real reason a long fight works is Blade of the Ruined King's %HP damage against a resist-stacked target.
audit.corrected: Max-stack Ionian Fervor attack speed plus BotRK %HP damage grinds through Living Forge resists. No shred, no shield to out-heal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four chart rows contradicted the whys text beside them. whys[2] says 'Level 3 is your spike' with the row reading Ornn; whys[3] says 'Trades go even' with the row reading Ornn; whys[5] says you 'out-pace a one-item Ornn — all-in now' with the row reading Ornn.
audit.why: The packet chart (Skill, Skill, Irelia, Skill, Irelia, Irelia, Ornn) matches the prose on every row.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 3, 5 flipped in matched full/content pairs with ratings 5/10 for even stages and 7/10 where Irelia wins.

audit.whatIsWrong: First-item spike named 'Trinity Force/Goredrinker' in whys[5], spikes[2].text and late, while the itemization block builds Blade of the Ruined King.
audit.why: Contradiction on one page, and BotRK is specifically the item that answers Ornn's resist stacking.
audit.corrected: All three renamed. Ornn's other spike, Call of the Forge God at 140/120/100s, is stated correctly.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere, and dosFull[1]/dosFull[2]/dontsFull carried template text unrelated to their titles.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture is 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s and Searing Charge 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s — Searing Charge is the long one and the real engage window. Searing Charge also only knocks up on terrain collision, which the page never said.
audit.corrected: Numbers and the terrain condition written into dosFull[1].d, dosFull[2] and dontsFull[0].d.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are a grind: he buys armor and your raw burst trades go even, so trade only when his pillar and E are down and bank chip damage rather than coinflipping into his knockup. Level 6 swings back to you — Vanguard's Edge walls off his retreat so he can't waddle to tower, and in a long fight your max-stack passive shreds the very resists he just built, which is the one thing tanks hate. This is your dive window with your jungler.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are a grind: he buys armor and your raw burst trades go even, so trade only when his pillar and E are down — Volcanic Rupture is 9s at rank 1, Searing Charge 14s — and bank chip rather than coinflipping into his knockup. Level 6 swings back to you: Vanguard's Edge walls off his retreat so he can't waddle to tower, and a long fight is where max-stack Ionian Fervor and %HP damage grind a tank down. This is your dive window with your jungler.

edits.before: Your first item (Trinity Force/Goredrinker with full reset uptime) is your last clean window — force the all-in here before he stacks a second tank item. After that he reclaims the lane: a 2+ item Ornn is a Brittle-applying, R-double-knockup teamfight monster who can flip you out of your dash chain, and his upgraded items plus raw resists out-stat your single-target shred. Convert your mid-game lead into towers and objectives and end before his tank scaling and Forge God ult take over.

After that he reclaims the lane: a 2+ item Ornn is a Brittle-applying, R-double-knockup teamfight monster who can flip you out of your dash chain, and Living Forge resists on top of masterwork items out-stat your single-target damage. Convert your mid-game lead into towers and objectives and end before his tank scaling and Forge God ult take over.

notes: Ornn was described as having a shield that heals ('melts him faster than his shield can heal'). He has no shield and no heal in his kit — that is a pure invention and it was the stated justification for taking extended fights. The correct justification is %HP damage from Blade of the Ruined King against a Living Forge resist-stacker, which is now what the text says. Same passive 'resist shred' fiction as the other entries in this slice. Chart flipped to the packet chart, which already matched the whys prose. suspectNames flag on wants.you[2] ('Use Vanguard's Edge') is a false positive — that is the correct name of Irelia's R.
